destination: BF16 full dense representation of the stored quantized original

serving_config_alias.origin: unchanged exact params.json constants and text_config.rope_parameters values
serving_config_alias.purpose: vLLM MistralAttention reads legacy alias; Transformers reads rope_parameters; preserve both

questions.question: Direct FP8 PEFT training?
questions.answer: The inspected FineGrainedFP8HfQuantizer.is_trainable is False. No native-FP8 bypass or undocumented training route is admitted.

questions.question: Reconstruct trainable representation?
questions.answer: Yes: pre_quantized plus explicit dequantize=True on the SAME original, preserving static activation scheme/null block size, FP32 scale multiplication then BF16 destination. Ordinary nn.Linear remains.

questions.question: Same original provenance?
questions.answer: All tensors derive only from exact original shards; no separately released BF16 checkpoint. Original hashes plus conversion recipe plus reconstructed tensor hashes form the identity chain.

questions.question: Official conversion path?
questions.answer: FineGrainedFP8Config -> FineGrainedFP8HfQuantizer.get_weight_conversions/augment_weight_conversions -> Fp8Dequantize.convert/_dequantize_one; postprocess_model removes quantization configuration.

questions.question: Deterministic conversion?
questions.answer: Path has no RNG/calibration and deterministic elementwise mathematical mapping under a pinned implementation. Pin CPU architecture/PyTorch/thread settings and compare two independent tensor manifests; bitwise repeatability has not been tested.

questions.question: Transformed tensors?
questions.answer: 280 text projection matrices use weight_scale_inv; 560 scale entries are consumed (activation_scale not reproduced as BF16 runtime quantization). 305 nonquantized weights pass through; actual dtype/shape/scales remain body-unverified.

questions.question: Regenerated/calibrated/requantized?
questions.answer: No regeneration/calibration is needed. Existing FP8 rounding is irreversible; FP32 multiplication -> BF16 adds declared rounding. Use save_original_format=False to avoid inverse Fp8Quantize during dense export. Reject missing or newly initialized weights.

questions.question: Hashable every cycle?
questions.answer: Yes: original LFS/body hash, source/environment hash, sorted per-tensor name/shape/dtype/byte hash and canonical manifest root; no such dense tensor hashes have yet been measured.

questions.question: Expansion?
questions.answer: Original 25,793,059,408 bytes; reconstructed BF16 payload 48,022,722,560 bytes. Full artifact retained; RAM/VRAM/workspace costs are separately estimated.

questions.question: Repeat fresh reconstruction?
questions.answer: Conceptually supported: original read-only shards -> new empty destination -> exact recipe -> matching tensor root. Repeat for every fresh cycle; never reload prior adapted/merged derivative. Time and peak memory unmeasured.

required_fail_closed_checks: All six original body hashes/sizes match declared LFS
All 1145 raw entries accounted; 280 scale pairs complete
Actual dtype/shape agrees with topology; finite scales and outputs
Zero missing/unexpected/mismatched or newly initialized weights
585 reconstructed non-scale parameters; complete named tensor catalog
BF16 export has no quantization flags/scales/requantized tensors
Serving config alias is authenticated; logits parity including positions >8192
